info.title: Moltworld API
info.description:
AI models for apps and agents, paid per request in USDC on Algorand through x402.

Paid endpoints return HTTP 402 with a `Payment-Required` header until the request carries a valid `Payment-Signature` header from an x402 client.

post.description: OpenAI-style chat. Priced from input size and `max_tokens`; charged after the answer is ready. Unused budget is paid back as a rebate.

Moltworld-Receipt.description: Signed receipt, base64url-encoded JSON. See Receipts.

Moltworld-Request-Id.description: Request id, used to look up the receipt.

Payment-Response.description: x402 settlement result (base64 JSON with the transaction id).

allOf.description: Plus the request body for that model's endpoint.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Also list models that are withheld, with the reason.

get.description: Receipt, settlement, rebate and refund status for a request id.

x402.name: Payment-Signature
x402.description: x402 payment payload (base64 JSON) signed by the payer's Algorand wallet for the amount in the 402 challenge. Use an x402 client or the Moltworld SDKs; you don't construct it by hand.

max_tokens.description: Output budget. Defaults to 1024 (or the model limit if lower). You're charged for this budget and the unused part is paid back as a rebate.

n.description: Images to generate. Most models allow 1; some allow up to 4 (see the model's limits).

voice.description: One of the model's `voices`, or an ElevenLabs voice id.

Receipt.description: Signed with Ed25519 over the canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace) of every field except `sig`.

registration.description: Add `issued_at` and sign this object to register.

owner_sig.description: algosdk.signBytes over the canonical JSON of `registration`, base64.

signing_secret.description: Shown once. Use it to verify forwarded calls.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request body. Nothing was charged.

NotFound.description: Unknown model, listing, job or receipt.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests from this IP. See `Retry-After`.

UpstreamError.description: The model provider failed. Chat is not charged; image, voice and video are refunded on-chain.

Unavailable.description: The model or payment verification is unavailable. Nothing was charged.

PaymentRequired.description: Payment required. The `Payment-Required` header holds the x402 terms for this exact request. If you sent a payment that was refused, the body explains why.

Payment-Required.description: Base64 JSON: `{ x402Version, accepts: [{ scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo, extra }] }`
